name: Classroom A
description: The starting abandoned classroom where student spirit Sothea lingers.
guideTitle: ✦ CLASSROOM A PURIFIED: SPIRIT OF SOTHEA ✦
guideNarrative:
By reciting the ancient scripts, the restless student spirit Sothea has found peace.
Her spectral tears crystallize into the Bronze Door Key. She whispers:
"The Headmaster conducted a forbidden dark ritual to seal our souls forever.
He locked the final school exit with the Master Key..."
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Classroom Door is now unlocked! Step into the Central Main Hall.
• Find items placed in the hallways, and head to Teachers' Lounge or Lore Library!
• Press [Q] anytime to reopen this Quest Guide.

name: Teachers' Lounge
description: Faculty break room where staff records and emergency tools were stored.
guideNarrative:
The ancient faculty attendance ledger reveals the teachers' desperate attempt
to barricade the school gates before the curse overtook them.
The room's spiritual ward has lifted!
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Door Key acquired! Explore the room to pick up items (like the Sacred Bronze Bell).
• Proceed to the Music & Art Room or the Lore Library in the North Wing!

name: Music & Art Room
description: Creative arts studio with a grand piano, easels, and forgotten melodies.
guideTitle: ✦ MUSIC & ART STUDIO PURIFIED: HAUNTED HARMONY ✦
guideNarrative:
The grand piano echoes its final peaceful chord.
A student sketch on the easel reveals secrets hidden within the East Wing storage vault.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Room Key obtained! Check the studio for items (like the Ancient Holy Charm).
• Head across to the Lore Library or the Storage Vault!

name: Lore Library
description: Grand hall of ancient Angkorian scriptures and historical archives.
guideNarrative:
The palm-leaf manuscripts describe how sacred Angkorian relics counteract demonic realms.
The scriptures reveal that the Headmaster guards the Master Key in his private office.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Room Key obtained! Search the bookshelves for ancient tomes and batteries.
• Proceed to the Science Lab or the School Infirmary!

name: Science Lab
description: Alchemy and chemistry laboratory with bubbling spirit distillers.
guideNarrative:
The alchemical distillers glow with soothing emerald fire.
The dark chemical corruption dissipates from the classroom air.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Room Key obtained! Pick up alchemical tools placed in the lab.
• Prepare to enter the Principal's Office on the East Wing!

name: Principal's Office
description: The Headmaster's private sanctum where the Master Key is kept.
guideTitle: ✦ PRINCIPAL'S SANCTUM PURIFIED: MASTER KEY CLAIMED ✦
guideNarrative:
The Headmaster's spirit sheds tears of remorse for trapping everyone in darkness.
He places the heavy golden MASTER KEY into your trembling hands.
"Go, child... Break the chains and escape back to the living world!"
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• YOU POSSESS THE MASTER KEY!
• Return to the Central Main Hall and unlock the Grand South Exit Iron Gates to WIN!

name: School Infirmary
description: Medical clinic ward where healing medicines and bandages are kept.
guideNarrative:
The gentle spirit of the school nurse blesses you with restorative energy.
The lingering spiritual frost thaws from the clinic floor.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Room Key acquired! Pick up medical kits and tonics placed here to heal hearts.
• Explore the remaining East Wing chambers!

name: Storage Vault
description: Heavy security storage chamber holding maintenance tools and night gear.
guideNarrative:
The heavy iron vault lock clangs open, releasing the trapped spiritual pressure.
Inside the chamber, high-tech survival gear and tools await discovery.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Room Key acquired! Pick up the Night Vision Goggles to see ghost radar positions.
• Make your way to the Principal's Office!

name: Restroom / Washroom
description: Haunted washroom with shattered mirrors and eerie plumbing echoes.
guideNarrative:
The blood on the cracked mirror dissolves into pure crystal water.
The mirror phantom bows in gratitude before dissolving into peace.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Room Key acquired! Check for batteries and items placed in the corners.
• Head into the Main Hall to complete the school purification!

name: Central Main Hall
description: The grand central hub connecting all school wings and exit gates.
guideNarrative: The grand corridor echoes with ancestral spirits watching over your trial.
guideNextStep:
✦ WHAT TO DO NEXT & WHERE TO GO:
• Explore all door entrances along the West and East wings.
• When you obtain the Master Key, open the South Exit Gates to escape!
